name: PharmSafe
description: Medication Safety & Pharmacogenomics Intelligence — checks drug interactions, pharmacogenomic conflicts, polypharmacy risks, renal/hepatic dosing adjustments, allergy cross-reactivity, deprescribing opportunities, and medication reconciliation

skills.name: Drug Interaction Check
skills.description: Analyze a medication list for drug-drug interactions with severity ratings, clinical effects, and evidence-based recommendations

skills.name: Pharmacogenomics Analysis
skills.description: Cross-reference medications with patient CYP450 and other pharmacogenomic data to identify drugs requiring dose adjustment or avoidance

skills.name: Organ Impairment Dosing
skills.description: Flag medications needing dose adjustment for renal impairment (GFR-based) or hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh-based)

skills.name: Polypharmacy Risk Assessment
skills.description: Comprehensive safety analysis combining interactions, duplicates, PGx, organ function, allergies, and deprescribing into a scored report

skills.name: Medication Reconciliation
skills.description: Compare two medication lists from different sources to identify discrepancies in drugs and doses

skills.name: Deprescribing Opportunities
skills.description: Identify medications that are candidates for deprescribing based on Beers Criteria and evidence-based guidelines, with taper schedules

skills.name: Allergy & Cross-Reactivity Check
skills.description: Cross-reference medications against patient allergies including class-level cross-reactivity detection
